wargear.name: Shadow-banner
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Shadow-banner adds 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic and has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A dull black standard of dark feathers that seems to drink the light around it.

wargear.name: Corvid dirge-shroud
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Corvid dirge-shroud has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A tattered mourning-cloak worn over the armour of the Isstvan survivors, hiding the bearer in smoke and sorrow.

wargear.name: Night-sight visor
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Night-sight visor has the Dark Sight Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A black-lensed visor tuned to the dark between stars.

wargear.name: Raptor-pinion harness
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Raptor-pinion harness has the Pinion Glide Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A light glide-frame of feathered vanes.

wargear.name: Gloom smoke launchers
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Gloom smoke launchers has the Gloom Veil Special Rule.
wargear.summary: Banks of shadow-smoke tubes along the hull.

wargear.name: Pathfinder's markers
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with Pathfinder's markers has the Hidden Trail Special Rule.
wargear.summary: Hooded beacons left along the approach.

wargear.name: Dirge banner
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Dirge banner has the Standard of the Dirge Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A banner of black feathers bearing the names of the dead.

wargear.name: Talon-sheath gauntlets
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Talon-sheath gauntlets has the Raven's Strike Special Rule, and adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic in any Battle Turn in which its Unit made a Charge.
wargear.summary: Spring-loaded blades concealed in the wrists.

wargear.name: Crest of Kiavahr
wargear.summary: A crest of black feathers from the first flock he raised on his homeworld.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Crest of Kiavahr has the Feint of the Raven Special Rule.

wargear.name: Obsidian pinion-lenses
wargear.summary: Black glass set in the brow, ground to catch light no other eye can use.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Obsidian pinion-lenses adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

wargear.name: Mantle of Lost Brothers
wargear.summary: A cloak sewn from the shrouds of the Legion dead, each feather a name.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Mantle of Lost Brothers has an Invulnerable Save of 3+ against Shooting Attacks.

rites.name: Wings of the Corvid
rites.flavor: A hundred shapes drop out of the smoke, and by the time you count them they are among you.
benefits: Dark Fury and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots.
Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains Out of the Smoke: on the turn it arrives by Deep Strike it may have a Charge declared for it with no penalty.
limitations: Every Antigrav Infantry unit must start the battle in Reserve, and at least one Dark Fury Squad is required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Terminator squads.

modifiers.text: Wings of the Corvid: Out of the Smoke.

require.note: Bring at least one Dark Fury Squad.

rites.name: Whispers in the Dark
rites.flavor: The enemy never sees the first hundred. The hundred and first is already behind him.
benefits: Reconnaissance, Scout and Mor Deythan Squads may fill Troops slots.
Reconnaissance and Scout Squads gain Unseen Hunters: during the first Battle Turn enemy units may not Shoot at or Charge them unless they begin the turn within 12".
limitations: At least one Reconnaissance or Scout Squad is required.
No Armour, Support, Heavy Transport, War Engine or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Whispers in the Dark: Unseen Hunters.

require.note: Bring a Reconnaissance or Scout Squad.

rites.name: Survivors of the Black Dirge
rites.flavor: Isstvan took the Legion's wings. What was left learned to stand.
benefits: Deliverers Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Deliverers gain Last Stand of the Dirge: they automatically pass Leadership Checks and Cool Checks.
limitations: Corvus Corax must lead the army, and at least one Deliverers Squad is required.
No Recon or Fast Attack units, and no unit may start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: Survivors of the Black Dirge: Line (1), Last Stand of the Dirge.

require.note: Bring at least one Deliverers Squad.

rites.name: Knives Among the Stars
rites.flavor: One blade, one name, one quiet corridor, and the war ends before it begins.
benefits: Moritat, Moritat Mortalis, Pathfinders and Kaedes Nex gain Blade in the Dark (after both sides deploy, each may make a free move of up to 6") and Close Work (+1 to Hit Tests with Pistol and Assault Trait weapons).
limitations: At least two of Moritat, Moritat Mortalis, Pathfinder or Kaedes Nex are required.
At most one High Command unit, and no Retinue or Heavy Assault units.

modifiers.text: Knives Among the Stars: Blade in the Dark, Close Work.

limit.note: At most one High Command unit.

rules.name: Out of the Smoke
rules.summary: A hundred shapes drop out of the smoke and are among you before you can count them.
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule that arrives by Deep Strike may have a Charge declared for it in the Charge Sub-Phase of the same Player Turn.

rules.name: Unseen Hunters
rules.summary: The enemy never sees the first hundred.
rules.text: During the first Battle Turn, enemy Units may not target a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule with a Shooting Attack or declare a Charge against it unless they begin the Battle Turn within 12" of it.

rules.name: Last Stand of the Dirge
rules.summary: Isstvan took the Legion's wings, and what was left learned to stand.
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule automatically passes any Leadership Check or Cool Check it is required to make.

rules.name: Blade in the Dark
rules.summary: One blade, one name, one quiet corridor.
rules.text: After both players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule may make one Set-up Move of up to 6". It may not end that move within 9" of an enemy Model.

rules.name: Dark Sight
rules.summary: A black-lensed visor tuned to the dark between stars.
rules.text: The first time in each Shooting Attack that a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule would suffer a -1 modifier to a Hit Test because of Shrouded or cover, ignore that modifier.

rules.name: Pinion Glide
rules.summary: Feathered vanes carry the bearer over ground that would stop others.
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule adds 2" to the distance it may move when it Rushes, and that Model ignores the effects of Difficult Terrain.

rules.name: Gloom Veil
rules.summary: Shadow-smoke swallows the hull before the enemy can find it.
rules.text: Once per Battle, at the start of the enemy Shooting Phase, the Controlling Player of a Vehicle with this Special Rule may declare that all Shooting Attacks made against it in that Phase are made as Snap Shots.

rules.name: Hidden Trail
rules.summary: Hooded beacons mark a path only the Legion can follow.
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule makes a Set-up Move, it may move 3" further forward. During the first Battle Turn, it cannot be targeted by Shooting Attacks made from more than 24" away.

rules.name: Standard of the Dirge
rules.summary: A banner of black feathers bearing the names of the dead.
rules.text: A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the Cool Characteristic of its Models. Once per Battle, the Unit may ignore the effects of the Routed Status, the Pinned Status or the Suppressed Status until the end of the current Phase.

rules.name: Raven's Strike
rules.summary: The raven strikes before its prey has settled.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule that made a Charge this Battle Turn adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic during the first Initiative Step of that Combat.

rules.name: Close Work
rules.summary: The knife-men do their killing at arm's length and do not miss.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks made with Weapons that have the Pistol Special Rule or the Assault Trait.

rules.name: Liberator of Lycaeus
rules.summary: He came to Lycaeus to break chains, and the Legion still walks in the shape of that mercy.
rules.text: This Model loses the Deep Strike Special Rule and must be Deployed on the battlefield. Friendly Raven Guard Units within 12" of this Model add 1 to their Cool Characteristic.

rules.name: Hunter of the Hollow Hours
rules.summary: He strikes out of the unlit sky and is gone before the guns can turn.
rules.text: In a Player Turn in which this Model arrives from Reserves using the Deep Strike Special Rule, it adds 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls, and enemy Models in any Combat it charges subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic until the end of that Assault phase. This Model subtracts 1 from its Toughness Characteristic.

rules.name: Mourner of Isstvan
rules.summary: Grief has made him a closer, harder killer than the Legion remembers.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic. Once in each Battle Turn, when a friendly Raven Guard Model within 12" of this Model is removed as a casualty, this Model adds 1 to its Strength Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Feint of the Raven
rules.summary: A flash of dark wings, and the charge has already missed.
rules.text: Enemy Units that declare a Charge against a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from the result of their Charge Rolls.

armyRules.name: Lightfoot Raiders
armyRules.flavor: Raven Guard raiders slip through ground others cannot cross.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 2" to the distance it may move when it Rushes or makes a Set-up Move.
drawbacks: While Locked in Combat with an enemy Unit that has more Models, every Model in the Unit subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic.
armyRules.condition: while locked in Combat with a unit that has more models

armyRules.name: Ghost of the Shadow War
armyRules.flavor: The shadow war is fought from the dark, at a distance of the enemy's choosing.
benefits: When an enemy Unit makes a Shooting Attack against a Unit with this Special Rule from more than 18" away, subtract 1 from the Hit Tests.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the Hit Tests of its own Shooting Attacks made against targets more than 24" away.

armyRules.name: Dirge-Marked Survivors
armyRules.flavor: Isstvan taught the Legion how to die slowly.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic.
drawbacks: If a Unit with this Special Rule lost a Model to an enemy Unit during the previous Battle Turn, it must declare a Charge against that Unit if able.

armyRules.name: Black Wings Gathering
armyRules.flavor: While the Lord of Shadows watches the field, the Legion falls on it from every side.
benefits: While Corvus Corax is on the battlefield, friendly Raven Guard Infantry Units add 1 to the result of their Charge Rolls in any Player Turn in which they arrive from Reserves, and Reserve Rolls made for them are made with a +1 modifier.
drawbacks: A friendly Raven Guard Infantry Unit that was Deployed on the battlefield subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Rolls in the first Battle Turn.
If Corvus Corax is removed as a casualty, Reserve Rolls made for friendly Raven Guard Units subtract 1 for the rest of the battle.
armyRules.condition: on a turn the unit arrives from Reserves
